official-b85c3cfa.note: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini @ b85c3cfa615fc413cc9af3379f491b963f3b586a (Apache-2.0): one 18.2 GiB mixed NVFP4/MXFP8 checkpoint (routed experts NVFP4 in layers 0-19 and MXFP8 in layers 20-23; attention, embeddings and unembed BF16) plus the 0.59 GiB DSpark draft head in mtp.safetensors. weights_gib is the on-disk size before any load; replace it with the measured resident value.

vllm-inkling2-r001.note: Relocatable uv CPython 3.12.13 (same interpreter bytes as the qwen3.8-flash-next runtime) with the vLLM nightly 0.34.0rc1.dev1133+g647a76866 (prebuilt aarch64 cu130 wheel, ships vllm/models/inkling2) plus patches/inkling2 (PR #69288 behind the default-off INKLING2_MAX_CTAS_POW2). Package versions and the patched tree digest go in the build manifest once the install is frozen.

cuda.note: Upstream vLLM nightly 647a76866 Inkling 2 model code (NVFP4/MXFP8 experts, Triton MoE path on SM12x); not yet loaded on GB10.
